svg.text: From payment exception to trusted decision: the PeX workflow in 8 steps
Four PeX phases, one case. Personal data is tokenized at intake and on every evidence reply. Example: an invalid IBAN on a GBP 8,650 CHAPS payment.
Only tokens and facts come out.
leave PeX only here and in
Demo: the bank, its APIs and the rails are simulated. PeX never executes or settles a payment itself.
